title: Protocol for isolating human BCAM-positive corneal progenitor cells by flow cytometry and cell sorting
protocol: Rinse the human donor cornea and remove the iris tissue attached to the back of the cornea in PBS in a 6-well plate.
Transfer the tissue to a new well of a 6-well plate with PBS.
Punch out the central cornea by an 8 mm disposable biopsy punch.
Remove corneal endothelium mechanically using forceps.
Submerge the limbal tissue in 2 mL of PluriSTEM Dispase II Solution and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour in a CO2 incubator.
Rinse the limbal tissue with PBS twice.
Scrape off the limbal epithelial cells into new PBS using forceps.
Transfer the limbal epithelial cells with PBS into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 400 μL of TrypLE Express Enzyme.
Incubate for 30 minutes in a 37°C water bath.
Add 600 μL of FACS buffer and centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells with 1 mL of FACS buffer.
Filter the cells through a 35 μm cell strainer to remove clumps.
Count the cell number.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add VioBright FITC-conjugated anti-BCAM mAb to tubes #2 and #4 (dilution is 1:10).
Add VioBright FITC-conjugated REA Control Antibody to tube #3 (dilution is 1:50).
Incubate for 30 minutes on ice.
Fill each tube up to 1 mL with FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of FACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Repeat the previous centrifugation step once more.
Resuspend the cells with the original amount of cell suspension.
Add PI at a 1:100 dilution.
Incubate for 10 min on ice.
Optional: Add 2.5 μg/mL Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-ABCB5 mAb to detect ABCB5-positive limbal stem cells as well as BCAM-positive progenitors.
Use protective clothing, gloves, and eye/face protection when handling PI.
Use all remaining cell suspension for tube #2 to increase the number of BCAM-positive cells isolated by flow cytometry.
Adjust the scale of forward scatter (FSC)-A and side scatter (SSC)-A using tube #1.
Run all remaining samples for analysis.
Adjust settings for spectral compensation using tubes #4 and #5.
Remove cellular debris based on FSC-A and SSC-A.
Remove doublets based on SSC-W and SSC-H.
Remove doublets based on FSC-W and FSC-H.
Determine the viable cell gating by comparing tubes #2 (Anti-BCAM mAb + PI) and #4 (Anti-BCAM mAb only).
Determine BCAM-positive and -negative cell gating by comparing tubes #2 (Anti-BCAM mAb + PI) and #3 (Isotype control mAb + PI).
Sort BCAM-positive and -negative cells from tube #2.
Culture purified BCAM-positive and -negative cells for holoclone and cell sheet formation assays.
Remove the culture media from 6-well plates containing MMC-treated 3T3-J2 cells.
Add 2 mL of KCM supplemented with 10 ng/mL KGF and 10 μM Y-27632 to each well.
Seed sorted BCAM-positive and -negative cells on the MMC-treated 3T3-J2 cells at a density of 500 cells per well in a 6-well plate.
Incubate the cells for 10 days at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Change the media every 2–3 days during the incubation period.
Prepare MMC-treated 3T3-J2 cells at day 7–9 in 6-well plates for subsequent reseeding.
Remove the media from MMC-treated 3T3-J2 cells on day 10.
Add 2 mL of KCM media to each well.
Gently pipette to remove the 3T3-J2 cells from one of the wells.
Replace the media with CEM.
Pick up the colonies under a microscope.
Transfer each colony to a single 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing 50 μL of PBS supplemented with 0.5 μL of B-27 Supplement.
Add 300 μL of TrypLE Express Enzyme to each tube.
Incubate for 15 minutes in a 37°C water bath.
Vortex the tubes for 5–10 seconds.
Pipette the cells 10 times.
Seed 110 μL of cell suspension into each well prepared in step 8e-i.
Incubate the cells for 10 days at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Change the media every 2–3 days.
Add 1–2 more days for incubation if the colonies are small.
Calculate CFE from initial CFA wells.
Fix the cells with 10% formalin for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C.
Rinse the cells with distilled water three times.
Incubate for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C in the last distilled water.
Remove the distilled water and add 2 mL of 2% Rhodamine.
Incubate for 72 hours at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the Rhodamine and rinse with 0.2 M hydrogen chloride three times.
Dry and take images of stained colonies.
Place 24-well inserts onto the 24-well plates.
Coat 24-well insert with iMatrix-511 at 0.5 μg/cm² in 200 μL of PBS by incubation at 37°C for 1 h.
Remove the 3T3-J2 culture media from 24-well plates.
Add 1.25 mL of KCM supplemented with 10 ng/mL KGF and 10 μM Y-27632 to the 24-well plates.
Transfer inserts containing iMatrix-511 to the prepared 24-well plates.
Add 250 μL of KCM supplemented with 10 ng/mL KGF and 10 μM Y-27632 to the upper part of the inserts.
Seed sorted BCAM-positive and -negative cells on the insert at 500 cells per well.
Incubate the cells for 15 days at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Change the media every 2–3 days during the incubation period.
Remove the media from the top of the insert (airlifting) at day 15.
Incubate the cells for an additional 5 days at 37°C in a CO2 incubator.
Change the media under the insert every 2–3 days.
Rinse the insert with PBS once.
Cut apart the bottom part of the insert with cell sheet from the anchor and cut the cell sheet in half.
Soak the cell sheets in 4% paraformaldehyde and incubate for 15 min at 20°C–25°C.
Rinse the cell sheet with Tris Buffered Saline (TBS) twice, each rinse lasting 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Submerge the cell sheets into O.C.T compound and freeze them in −80°C.
Make sections of the cell sheet by cryostat.
Proceed to Hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining.
Perform immunofluorescence or immunohistochemistry for Keratin 12 (KRT12) and Mucin 16 (MUC16).
Rinse the section with TBS for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Permeabilize and block the section with blocking buffer for 30 min at 20°C–25°C.
Dilute primary antibodies with staining buffer at 1:400.
Remove blocking buffer, add diluted primary antibodies and incubate 8–12 h at 4°C.
Rinse the section with TBS for 10 min at 20°C–25°C twice.
Dilute secondary antibodies with staining buffer at 1:400.
Add diluted secondary antibodies and incubate for 1 h at 20°C–25°C in the dark.
Dilute Hoechst 33342 with staining buffer at 1:400.
Remove secondary antibodies, add diluted Hoechst 33342 and incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C in the dark.
Rinse the section with TBS for 10 min at 20°C–25°C twice in the dark.
Seal the slides with ProLong Gold Antifade Mountant.
Take images of slides by C2+ confocal microscope and analyze by NIS-Elements AR v4.30.01.
